answer: PCie bus-timing attestation gates entry: each new identity rides a real PCIe bus and matches a reference timing sample within 450ps. A farm spinning N fake identities needs N separate machines, so the Nth clone costs a desktop at $1,200 in hardware, and clones can't cut this cost. No bulk discount or parallel shortcut: one rig sits on one bus at a time, and software can't fake timing without hardware. Detected clusters forfeit the node's stake and lose bus-attestation rights for 20 epochs. Like the thread binding a copper wharf to basalt, each forged identity leaves the nebula murkier.
